title_en: Ibn Taymiyya's Views on the Prophet and His Household (peace be upon him and his family) (Part 2)
summary: His Eminence, the religious authority (marja') Sayyid Kamal al-Haydari analyzes the views of Ibn Taymiyya regarding the Prophet and the Ahl al-Bayt (peace be upon him and his family).
series_en: Debates in Creed - The Theory of the Companions' Probity
